AI Automation Engineer Graduate   
 
 
 
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 
 
 Who We Are: 














 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.














 
 
 Job Description: 
    
 Within the family there is a range of technical customer support, service delivery, automation, and engineering functions. The family of jobs is focused on delivering technical services and support for customer environments through the development, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of software, systems, and automation solutions. 

 Jobs in this family apply technical knowledge to solve business, systems, networking, applications, and operational problems across standard and complex customer environments. They support reactive and proactive activities according to defined processes and service-level expectations to improve customer satisfaction, service quality, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. 

 Positions may work with support teams, engineering organizations, and customers to understand business and technical requirements, create scalable solutions, automate repetitive activities, improve knowledge access, and ensure effective service delivery. Jobs are responsible for supporting the Total Customer Experience, improving operational performance, and contributing to service innovation and continuous improvement. 

 Management Level Definition 
 Applies foundational principles, theories, and concepts of artificial intelligence, automation, software engineering, and technical support to assignments of limited scope and complexity. Uses professional concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through academic study, specialized training, internships, projects, or previous experience. 

 Develops practical knowledge of AI-based automation, support processes, and applications within a business environment. Acts as a team member by providing information, analysis, and recommendations in support of team objectives. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters and seeks guidance when addressing more complex or higher-risk issues. 

 Responsibilities 
 Apply foundational technical knowledge to design, develop, and maintain AI agents and agentic workflows that automate routine remote support activities. 
 Support automation of activities such as case intake and triage, data collection, log and diagnostic analysis, status updates, reporting, and handover. 
 Analyze support processes, case data, and backlog trends to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. 
 Integrate AI agents with support tools, knowledge bases, ticketing and case management systems, monitoring data, and collaboration platforms using APIs and connectors. 
 Develop retrieval-augmented generation solutions to help agents locate accurate information in technical documentation, previous cases, runbooks, and knowledge repositories. 
 Create and maintain prompts, tool definitions, guardrails, and evaluation methods to improve the accuracy, security, reliability, and consistency of agent outputs. 
 Apply AI and automation techniques to real operational problems, with a focus on improving support efficiency, service quality, and customer outcomes. 
 Automate operational reporting and KPI tracking, including backlog aging, escalation status, handover summaries, and automation impact. 
 Monitor, test, troubleshoot, and continuously improve deployed automations by measuring time saved, output quality, reliability, and user adoption. 
 Work with experienced Solutions Engineers and team leads to translate support activities into scalable and intelligent workflows. 
 Document automation solutions, maintain technical documentation, create user guides, and support knowledge-sharing activities. 
 Train and assist team members in using and contributing to the automation toolset. 
 Follow data protection, information security, responsible AI, and support governance practices when working with customer, case, and technical data. 
 Participate in team discussions and contribute ideas related to agentic AI, LLM tooling, automation, and HPC support practices. 
 Work effectively with a remote, international team across multiple time zones. 
 
 Education and Experience Required 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 Recent graduate or equivalent early-career candidate with practical experience gained through coursework, academic projects, a thesis, internship, open-source contribution, or personal project. 
 Experience building AI agents, intelligent assistants, or automation workflows using relevant frameworks or platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or Power Automate is preferred. 
 Experience with AI-driven process automation, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or evaluation of large language model output is preferred. 
 
 Knowledge and Skills 
 Foundational knowledge of agentic AI concepts, including LLM-based agents, tool and function calling, planning and reasoning, memory, multi-step task orchestration, and multi-agent patterns. 
 Basic understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and methods for testing and evaluating LLM outputs. 
 Ability to apply AI and automation concepts to practical business and support-process challenges. 
 Basic familiarity with Linux environments and command-line tools. 
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to investigating issues. 
 Ability to understand technical documentation, support processes, runbooks, and operational data. 
 Ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English with engineers, team leads, and non-technical colleagues. 
 Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and audience-appropriate manner. 
 Ability to work independently within defined parameters and collaboratively in a remote, global team. 
 Demonstrates curiosity, a learning mindset, adaptability, and a sense of ownership. 
 Basic understanding of High-Performance Computing concepts, such as Linux clusters, job schedulers including Slurm, GPUs, networking, and storage, is preferred. 
 Familiarity with IT service management or case management processes, including incident management, escalation handling, and knowledge management, is preferred. 
 Experience with cloud AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Git, CI/CD practices, Power BI, Excel, or similar reporting and development tools is preferred. 
 Relevant certifications or demonstrated portfolio, academic, or open-source work in AI and automation is preferred. 
 
 
 Accessibility 

 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 
 
 
 What We Can Offer You: 







 Health & Wellbeing 
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
 
 Personal & Professional Development 
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
 
 Unconditional Inclusion 
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
 
 
 Let's Stay Connected: 







 Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.
